This long, scarf-like garment appears to be made of living vines on which a dozen black roses bloom. While the vines appear to be thorny, they lack the capability to puncture or scratch, allowing the garland to be worn comfortably as a scarf or belt. The scent of the black roses evokes faint feelings of melancholy and nostalgia to the living, but undead find the odor to be unnerving and distracting. As long as you have a
invested, it grants a +1 item bonus to Deception and Intimidation checks against undead.

The illusionist's hat appears as a tall, black hat with a wide brim and a colorful band around its base. Although popularly associated with themes of magic, this hat is more the province of the entertainer or even the charlatan than of a proper arcanist, and many wizards scoff at those who openly wear such items. You gain a +1 item bonus to Deception checks made to
and to Thievery checks made to Palm an Object.

is invested, the images within shift in appearance to portray the two most important people in the wearer's life.
You open the cameo and regard the images within of the two most important people in your life, bolstering yourself with fond memories. You regain
Hit Points, and you gain a +2 status bonus to Will saves for 1 minute. You also immediately recover from any persistent damage you're currently taking.
